title: ERP Solution Architect
description:
Purpose of the Role
The ERP -Solution architect role is responsible for working jointly with the RheinBrücke direct Sales Management groups of an assigned Vertical to provide scoping, solutioning and estimation of the Professional Services effort required for new sales opportunities. Meanwhile the initial customer requirements are obtained by the Sales team, the Solution architect will work with the Sales team during the initial discovery and demo process to ensure that the prospect’s requirements are fully understood and included in the implementation SOW.
